In 1879 the City Lines Act authorized a connection between the Inner Circle and the East London .
This was to be owned jointly by the Metropolitan and the District and joined the East London Line just south of Whitechapel station .
With the withdrawal of the SER service the GER started running trains onto the East London Line in 1886 .
After the Circle Line was electrified Metropolitan and District trains were withdrawn .
